terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of Lematter. By using the service, you agree to be bound by these terms.
terms.s1Body: By accessing or using the service, you confirm that you can form a binding contract and that you accept these terms and agree to comply with them.
terms.s2Body: You agree to use the service only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these terms. You are responsible for any activity that occurs under your account.
terms.s3Body: We may revise these terms from time to time. The most current version will always be posted on this page, and continued use constitutes acceptance of the changes.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use Lematter.
privacy.s1Body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name and email address, as well as usage data generated as you interact with the service.
privacy.s2Body: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve the service, to communicate with you, and to keep the service secure.
privacy.s3Body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Lematter uses cookies and similar technologies to recognize you when you visit.
cookies.s1Body: Cookies are small data files placed on your device that help websites work and provide reporting information.
cookies.s2Body: We use essential cookies to operate the service and optional cookies to understand usage and improve your experience.
cookies.s3Body: You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings. Disabling some cookies may affect how the service functions.
